name: google-workspace
description: Google Workspace MCP: Gmail, Drive, Calendar, and Docs via taylorwilsdon/google_workspace_mcp

google_oauth_client_id.title: Google OAuth client ID
google_oauth_client_id.description: OAuth client ID (*.apps.googleusercontent.com) of the Google Cloud project authorized for the workspace MCP server.

google_oauth_client_secret.title: Google OAuth client secret
google_oauth_client_secret.description: OAuth client secret matching the client ID above.

user_google_email.title: Google account email
user_google_email.description: The Google account email whose Gmail/Drive/Calendar the server operates on; the OAuth consent screen names it.
